title: Quinta del Sol - Oceanfront condo
subtitle: Beachfront Residence in Puerto Aventuras
description:
Discover this exceptional oceanfront condominium at Quinta Sol, where luxury meets the pristine shores of Puerto Aventuras. This stunning residence offers an unparalleled beachfront lifestyle in one of the Riviera Maya's most coveted gated communities, featuring direct beach access and panoramic ocean views from your private terrace.

The thoughtfully designed interior spans sophisticated living space, complemented by a generous terrace perfect for entertaining or simply savoring the spectacular Caribbean sunsets. The residence features a modern fitted kitchen, air conditioning throughout, and a convenient laundry room, ensuring comfort and functionality in every detail.

Quinta Sol is a prestigious development comprising only 30 exclusive units, offering privacy and exclusivity while maintaining the warmth of a close-knit community. With 24-hour security, elevator access, and handicap accessibility, every convenience has been thoughtfully considered for the discerning buyer.

This rare offering provides an extraordinary opportunity to own a piece of paradise on the world-renowned Riviera Maya coastline, where crystal-clear waters meet white sandy beaches in perfect harmony. The property represents the epitome of coastal elegance and luxury living in this tropical sanctuary.
highlights: Oceanfront location with direct beach access
Private terrace with spectacular sunset views
Modern fitted kitchen and air conditioning
